arrest_intro.streak_trigger: Three consecutive errors this shift. The State has flagged your booth for review.
arrest_intro.total_trigger: Five errors this shift. The State has flagged your booth for review.

arrest_verdict: Your replacement is already at the gate.
You will not see your family again.

arrest_note_callback.note_read: I told you we'd meet again.
arrest_note_callback.note_ignored: You should have read the note, Inspector.

promoted_clean: The Inspector approaches your booth — not to interrogate, but to dismiss you.
"Inspector Selim-X. Your performance has been noted. Report to Senior Review on Monday. The State watches itself well when it watches itself through eyes like yours."
You collect your things. The booth is taken over by your replacement before you reach the elevator.
You're going up. You don't know what's up there.
promoted_dark: The Inspector approaches your booth — not to interrogate, but to dismiss you.
"Inspector Selim-X. Your performance has been noted. Report to Senior Review on Monday."
He hands you back your case ledger. "Your reports balance perfectly. Almost too perfectly. We'll be in touch."
You're going up. There's more than one way up.
continue_shift: The Inspector's footsteps fade past your booth. You sit alone with the directives for next week — already updated, already longer.
